3246.title: Pi bridge omits the native prefix for selected skills
3246.rootCauseOneLine: The Pi bridge forwards visible prompt text but does not translate structured skill mentions into Pi's required native skill command.
3246.proposedFix: Rewrite selected skill mention spans to Pi's native skill command syntax inside the Pi bridge while preserving arguments and ordinary text.
3246.caveats: The hermetic reproduction verifies the bridge boundary directly; no live model or user data was needed.
